name: Stormbringer: Thundershocker works natively (#1682)
contract: #1682: Thundershocker (300610) is a flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (23, i.e. effect index 2) modifier, EffectBasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = +30, class mask (0,0,2), which matches Eye of the Storm's own family-22 flags (0,0,2). The chain is 806307 -> periodic trigger 806455 -> trigger 807712, and 807712's own effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER (base 0); the modifier raises that amount from 0 to 30 on the root debuff itself, so 'while rooted by Eye of the Storm' is satisfied by construction. Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken applies it to any family-22 hit from the same caster (Unit.cpp), read here through spell_damage_taken on the rooted dummy (fixed base 1000 per apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md, target identifies the attacker), giving 1000 -> 1300. #2154: High Voltage (570191) is a flat SPELLMOD_DURATION (1) modifier, EffectBasePoints 999 + DieSides 1 = +1000 ms, class mask (0,0,16777216) matching Arm of Thorim's own triggered stun spell 570339 (flags (0,0,16777216)) and nothing else; Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION without requiring the target spell to opt into spell mods (SpellInfo.cpp), raising the stun's SpellDuration.dbc id 36 base of 1000 ms to 2000 ms. Both auras are snapshotted at application time, so each half re-triggers its aura after learning the talent instead of re-reading a stale one. Arm of Thorim (501433-501437) is also gated by the class-16 custom resource system (AscensionCompatData::ResourceCostRules, modules/mod-ascension-compat/src/AscensionCustomResourceData.h): it requires at least 1 stack of the 'Static' resource aura 803102 and consumes it entirely on cast (Consumption::All); AscensionResourceService::CheckCast (modules/mod-ascension-compat/src/AscensionCompat.cpp) returns SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER when the caster holds fewer stacks than required, independently of actual mana. The fixture grants 1 Static stack via set_aura immediately before each Arm of Thorim cast, since the cast fully drains it. Eye of the Storm (806307) and Arm of Thorim (501433) share StartRecoveryCategory 133 (the standard 1000-1500 ms global cooldown, Spell.cpp TriggerGlobalCooldown/GlobalCooldownMgr, keyed only by StartRecoveryCategory, independent of the per-spell cooldown reset_cooldown clears): the Arm of Thorim BASELINE cast triggers that shared GCD, so the Thundershocker recast of 806307 must wait for it to clear before casting, not only for 806307's own 30 s category cooldown (cleared by reset_cooldown).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the fixture has enough mana for a 37% base mana cast
Let the periodic trigger apply the root
BASELINE: Eye of the Storm's root debuff is applied
BASELINE: the root's own damage-from-caster amount is 0 without Thundershocker
BASELINE: Forked Lightning's incoming-damage query is the metric's fixed 1000 against the rooted target
SETUP: the fixture carries the Static charge Arm of Thorim's resource gate consumes (ResourceCostRules class 16, 501433-501437, amount 1, Consumption::All)
BASELINE: Arm of Thorim's stun lasts its DBC 1000 ms without High Voltage
BASELINE: Arm of Thorim's stun duration query is 1000 ms
BASELINE: the stun duration modifier query is unmodified
Let the shared GCD (StartRecoveryCategory 133, 1000-1500 ms) triggered by the Arm of Thorim BASELINE cast clear before recasting Eye of the Storm, which shares that category
Let the periodic trigger re-apply the root with Thundershocker learned
DISCRIMINATING: Thundershocker raises the root's damage-from-caster amount to 30
DISCRIMINATING: Forked Lightning's incoming-damage query against the rooted target rises to 1300
